title.en: W2/U7U8 companion: r2 FAIL evidence + r3 refreeze/window-readiness evidence (0-window)

intent.zh: 主卡 `2026-11-12-w2-u7u8-full-condition-assert` 运行中范围已冻结，按既有配套片规范新建本卡承载两个新证据目录：① `docs/development-evidence/g10-p5-mesh-cap32-window-r2-fail/`——r2 最小窗 attempt 1 FAIL 的 append-only 记录（verdict=FAILED、21 条 comparator 不一致明细、exit_code_capture_bug、monitor attempt-1 CSV、manifest 自核），严禁写成 PASS；② `docs/development-evidence/g10-p5-mesh-cap32-window-r3/`——r3 重冻清单（只重建 branch exe，9 旧 exe sha 不变）、18 守卫表、窗口就绪材料（pair 归一化明细 g1=1/g2=0/type1=6/type2=7、geomcollisionid 0..3 唯一、comparator failures=0 才 PASS、fail-stop、四前提勾表）、runner exit 捕获修复的自测日志。本卡不改产品 src/tests/判据/参考，不含窗口结论；r3 窗口由 Chief 按四前提另开。
intent.en: Companion card for the two new evidence dirs (r2 FAIL append-only record + r3 refreeze/readiness evidence); no product/test/criteria changes and no window conclusion here.

不改 `src/`/`tests/`/`fixtures/`/`scripts/`/判据/参考/comparator；不重跑窗口、不删 A2-3/r2 证据；UTF-8/LF 无 BOM；`policy_scan` 0 命中；manifest 逐文件自核
门禁 fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda/unit；`unchanged src/,fixtures/,scripts/,tests/`；不宣称 U7/U8 通过或任何窗口结论
